concept: ALB: HTTPS listener with an ACM certificate (TLS termination)
tests: What an ALB needs to encrypt client traffic in transit and terminate TLS at the load balancer.
expected: HTTPS listener on the ALB with a certificate from AWS Certificate Manager — TLS terminates at the ALB. Triggers: "encrypt in transit", "offload TLS termination at the load balancer".
why_not: An NLB with a TCP listener doesn't terminate TLS at L7; blocking 443 breaks HTTPS; a bucket policy applies to S3.
